title: Login API returns 500 due to missing JWT secret
description: User login requests are failing with HTTP 500 in staging. The server throws an error when trying to sign the token because JWT_SECRET is undefined in the runtime environment.
steps_to_reproduce: Start backend server in staging config
error_log:
Error: secretOrPrivateKey must have a value
    at Object.module.exports [as sign] (jsonwebtoken/sign.js:107:20)
expected_behavior: Login succeeds and returns a valid JWT token
actual_behavior: Login fails with 500 due to missing JWT signing secret
recent_changes: Environment variable cleanup removed duplicate secrets from deployment config
